name: Panther Mastery
label: Quest
description: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition offers a trial to those seeking to prove their prowess as big-game stalkers in Stranglethorn Vale. To join…
intro: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition offers a trial to those seeking to prove their prowess as big-game stalkers in Stranglethorn Vale. To join Hemet's hunting company, adventurers must first demonstrate their basic tracking ability by taking down ten young panthers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group Hemet has assembled, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter. We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry. Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.
Tracking them down is only half the challenge...

clips.title: Progress
paras: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, adventurer, and get back out there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Off to a good start, friend!
